goals: Verify that the `test` task correctly constructs and executes `pytest` commands based on various input parameters, including default settings, overrides, and arbitrary options.
Verify that the `coverage` task correctly configures and executes `pytest` for code coverage, manages report generation, integrates with `codecov`, and orchestrates calls to additional test tasks.
activities: Set up a mock context to expect 'pytest' to be run with default verbose, color, and syscapture flags, and pty enabled.
Execute the '_test_task' function using the mock context.
Verify that the 'pytest' command was executed exactly once with the default flags and pty enabled.
Set up a mock context to expect 'pytest' to be run with '--capture=no' and pty disabled.
Execute the '_test_task' function, explicitly setting verbose, color, pty, and capture options.
Verify that the 'pytest' command was executed exactly once with '--capture=no' and pty disabled.
Set up a mock context to expect 'pytest' to be run with additional arbitrary options like '-k 'lmao'', '-x', and '--whatever -man'.
Execute the '_test_task' function, passing 'k', 'x', and 'opts' arguments.
Verify that the 'pytest' command was executed exactly once with the combined arbitrary options.
Set up a mock context to expect 'pytest' to be run with the '--disable-warnings' flag.
Execute the '_test_task' function, setting 'warnings=False'.
Verify that the 'pytest' command was executed exactly once with the '--disable-warnings' flag.
Set up a mock context to expect 'pytest' to be run with default coverage flags ('--cov --no-cov-on-fail --cov-report=term').
Execute the 'coverage' task using the mock context.
Verify that the 'pytest' command was executed exactly once with the default coverage flags.
Set up a mock context to expect 'pytest' to be run with coverage flags for an XML report ('--cov --no-cov-on-fail --cov-report=xml').
Execute the 'coverage' task, requesting an XML report.
Verify that the 'pytest' command was executed exactly once with the XML coverage report flag.
Set up a mock context to expect 'pytest' to be run with default coverage flags and an additional custom option ('--cov --no-cov-on-fail --cov-report=term --meh').
Execute the 'coverage' task with an additional custom option.
Verify that the 'pytest' command was executed exactly once with the combined coverage and custom flags.
Create a MockContext instance.
Create a mock object for a test function.
Call the 'coverage' task, passing the mock context and the mock test function.
Verify that the mock test function was called once with the mock context and default coverage options.
Create a MockContext instance configured for multiple 'run' calls.
Create two mock objects for test functions.
Call the 'coverage' task, passing the mock context and a list of additional mock test functions.
Verify that the first mock test function was called once with the context and append coverage options.
Verify that the second mock test function was called once with the context and append coverage options.
Create a MockContext instance configured for multiple 'run' calls.
Call the 'coverage' task, requesting an HTML report.
Verify that a command to open the 'htmlcov/index.html' file was executed.
Create a MockContext instance configured for multiple 'run' calls.
Call the 'coverage' task without specifying 'codecov'.
Assert that the 'codecov' command was not executed.
Create a MockContext instance configured for multiple 'run' calls.
Call the 'coverage' task, enabling 'codecov' support.
Verify that the 'coverage xml' command was executed.
Verify that the 'codecov' command was executed.
